attributes.name: Blessing of Barbatos
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check; if this card has the Corrupted trait, add 1d4 instead.

When any character plays an ally on a check, discard this card to add 2 dice.

Discard this card to explore your location.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Corrupted trait, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
